label: Django API Surface Contract
description: Canonical API surface contract for Django/DRF profile retrieval, planning and future backend context-pack generation.

surface_families.name: contract
surface_families.purpose: Serializer, URL and DRF contract surface for Django APIs.

surface_families.name: handler
surface_families.purpose: ViewSet and view logic that exposes the API surface.

surface_families.name: service
surface_families.purpose: Business logic, filtering, tasks and query composition behind the API.

surface_families.name: persistence
surface_families.purpose: Model and migration surface supporting the API.

surface_families.name: integration
surface_families.purpose: Permissions, cross-app boundaries and background integrations.

surface_families.name: operations
surface_families.purpose: Admin, migrations and test surface that shape operational API behavior.

usage_rules.name: serializer-before-response-shape-drift
usage_rules.rule: API response and validation contracts should live in serializers before view-local shaping logic is introduced.
usage_rules.reason: This makes DRF retrieval consistent and explainable.

usage_rules.name: service-before-view-business-logic
usage_rules.rule: Business logic should live in services or query layers rather than ViewSet methods whenever complexity grows beyond trivial dispatch.
usage_rules.reason: Retrieval should separate API surface from domain behavior and query patterns.

usage_rules.name: admin-impact-is-contract-impact
usage_rules.rule: Model changes that affect Django Admin should be treated as part of backend operational contract, not as isolated persistence edits.
usage_rules.reason: In Django systems, operator workflows are part of the effective backend surface.
